summary: Independent review of Owner amendment A0001 (SPEC layer, tasks T035/T036). Identity and scope: candidate 98c8f6d is a single commit whose parent is the base 1fcb582; it changes 8 files - docs/spec/architecture/ARCHITECTURE.md (one ADR-012 catalogue row), docs/spec/architecture/adr/ADR-012-header-time-persistence-and-call-volume.md (new addendum), docs/spec/protocol/PROVIDER_FACTS.md (new planning-layer provider-facts record), todo/config.yaml (spec_revision v1-2026-09-14 -> v1-2026-09-17 only), the two target contracts T035.md and T036.md, and the workflow-written records todo/amendments/A0001/request.json and planner-001.json. Every changed path is inside SPEC-layer permissions (target contracts, spec_revision, docs/spec/**); no file under src/, tests/, tools/, .claude/, todo/reviews or todo/evidence changed, and no task status, attempt, dependency, commit, evidence or approval datum changed (programmatic config comparison: all task records, active_task, workflow_state and every non-spec_revision field are identical to base; T035/T036 remain PLANNED, attempt 0, depends_on [T030,T031,T032,T033,T034] and [T035]). The committed request.json is byte-identical to the runtime A0001-request.json, so the recorded Owner direction is exact. Owner direction mapping: the T036 reference target reproduces the direction verbatim (chain id 4663; PoolManager 0x8366a39cc670b4001a1121b8f6a443a643e40951; StateView 0xf3334192d15450cdd385c8b70e03f9a6bd9e673b; PoolKey currency0 0x5fc5360d0400a0fd4f2af552add042d716f1d168 USDG/6dp, currency1 0x7dbf38976f6d3b9c529e7d9484a71898b409ee6a ZZZ/18dp, fee 28001, tickSpacing 280, hooks 0x0; PoolId 0x6c614c38c65fea492f4cb2b90fd664f924a7b828c7384620662217e2e2df43ed; inclusive range 54946237..55946237, i.e. 1,000,001 blocks) and the addresses/chain id match the existing mainnet artifact docs/implement/protocol-artifacts/robinhood-chain-mainnet.json; the pinned PoolId re-derives exactly from the pinned PoolKey under the project's own compute_pool_id (keccak of the ABI-encoded PoolKey), so T036's required re-derivation check is satisfiable on the pinned values and the currency0<currency1 ordering invariant holds. All measured facts (a)-(h) are carried into the contracts and PROVIDER_FACTS.md (retrieval time 2026-09-17, head block 65392511): one pool-filtered [[5 topic0s], poolId] eth_getLogs call covering the range with 3739 events across 3266 blocks (counts internally consistent: 1+578+3159+1+0=3739), blockTimestamp 0x0, -32000 log query timed out, -32000 result-count limit 10000, HTTP 429, second endpoint about 10 blocks per call, JSON-RPC batching on both endpoints, and the historical-state asymmetry (9.4-10.4M blocks behind head checks out arithmetically). Owner points 4(a)-(d) are explicit: fixed acquisition shape with the new 'never one eth_getBlockByNumber per scanned block' prohibition and no eth_call during acquisition; deduplicated header logical calls with the logical-vs-HTTP-batch split; the header record, Parquet columns and manifest header table as a required trio (replacing 'two carriers are complementary'); and T036's capability-bounded start/middle/end sample that reports an unservable window as blocked via the existing T034 reason code cross_endpoint_sample_missing (a blocking code, so the blocked path is coherent) and never re-reads the first endpoint. ADR-012 records the header/time persistence location and acquisition call-volume principle, declares itself an addendum, reopens ADR-002/ADR-010 (both untouched, and their cited decision numbers - ADR-010 decisions 2/3/9 and ADR-011's logical-call rule - exist as referenced), and is registered in the ADR catalogue; spec_revision was raised; T030-T034 contract text is untouched. Acceptance standards are preserved and strengthened, never weakened (all base acceptance/must-not clauses remain; T035 adds position uniqueness and three-carrier consistency plus batch accounting; T036 adds pinned-identity/baseline discrepancy checks and capability-bounded result-bearing sampling). Dependency consistency holds: no dependency edits were made, each contract's Dependencies section still equals config depends_on, tools.workflow validate reports OK, and tests/test_config.py + tests/test_workflow.py + tests/test_workflow_contracts.py pass (92 passed), including the test that enforces contract-dependencies-equal-config and task-contract completeness. Consistency with higher-priority Intent (revision unchanged) holds: the change reinforces G-DATA-FREE-01 (measured-capability routing, budget recording, fail-closed), G-CHAIN-01 (chain id recorded and verified), G-RESEARCH-01 and G-ENV-01, and the pinned pool is an Owner-pinned ingestion qualification fixture rather than a system-selected target token (T036 makes no admission, eligibility or live-trading claim). No unrelated requirements, no credential-bearing URL or secret in the new text, and git diff --check is clean. Non-findings recorded for the Manager (explicitly not findings against A0001 and therefore not required changes): (1) todo/phases/P03-ingestion-and-storage/README.md's task list omits T035/T036, but that is a base-commit condition unchanged since 1fcb582 and SPEC-layer permissions allow only the two target contracts, spec_revision and docs/spec/**, so this amendment could not edit it; (2) T036's body does not restate measured fact (g) (JSON-RPC batching) because header retrieval is T035's clause - the fact is carried in T035 deliverable 2, PROVIDER_FACTS.md fact 7 and ADR-012; (3) T035's closure sentence attributes the per-event-block manifest header table to T031's manifest-row clauses, while T031 specifies per-partition manifest rows - the table itself is required verbatim by Owner direction 4(c) and no functional gap exists; (4) the pinned reference pool is ZZZ/USDG while CLAUDE.md/README mention FLYBRAIN/USDG, but the binding Intent revision names no token, the recorded Owner direction explicitly pins this pool, and T036 claims no strategy or admission role; (5) the 2026-09-17 facts are Owner-supplied observations, and the amended contracts themselves require each run to re-probe endpoint capability and compare its own counts against the baseline. None of these blocks or defers approval, so required_changes and unknowns are both empty.
